stage_canvas.help: Drag an icon from the list, or select it and press Enter. Arrow keys to move, Shift + arrows to move faster, Alt + arrows for fine adjustment, Alt while dragging with the mouse to ignore the grid, Delete to remove. On the selected item, the bottom right handle sets the size, the top left one sets the angle (in 15° steps, or hold Alt for a free angle) and the top right button snaps it to the next quarter turn.
